scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -w packages/onajs -w packages/create-onajs && npm run release
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -w packages/onajs -w packages/create-onajs && npm run release
scripts.release:major: npm version major -w packages/onajs -w packages/create-onajs && npm run release
scripts.release: npm run sync-version && npm run build && npm publish -w packages/onajs --access public && npm publish -w packages/create-onajs --access public
scripts.postrelease: git push && git push --tags && gh release create v$(node -p "require('./packages/onajs/package.json').version") --generate-notes
